highlights: UGREEN OTG Type-C to USB-A 3.0 Adapter - 20808

Ugreen 20808 Type-C to USB-A Adapter will tackle the problem, adding a USB A port to USB C enabled devices, so that you can connect standard USB peripheral, such as flash drive, USB Hub, printer cable, card reader, keyboard or mouse etc to your USB c Smartphone, tablet, MacBook, laptop for data transmission.
For USB C OTG Supported phones, this converter can turn your phone as a host, then you can enjoy movies or music directly from your USB flash drive.
You can also gaming with a USB game handle, typing with a keyboard etc.
Much more convenient operation bring better working and entertainment experience.
Type C OTG function for supported devices with USB C port
